Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/redaction.py

src/agent_runtime/redaction.py

Python · Tier A

Project optional credential masking for explicitly owned model, UI, log and trace consumers. Canonical execution and recovery values stay with their callers; this module combines live settings with accepted run policy, builds provenance-based matchers, and streams display copies. Disabled sources preserve input identity. Enabled traversal assumes acyclic supported data; mandatory public-error/OAuth privacy boundaries are separate. Matcher caches retain material in process memory, while stream buffers and ContextVar scopes belong to one consumer lifetime. See also: src/manual/content/architecture/31-redaction.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
RedactionSource 36 Name the twenty independently configured projection consumers. A source selects masking policy, not permission to execute or a replacement for canonical evidence.
RedactionPolicy 62 Immutable, strict-boolean switches for every consumer. Construction defaults all fields off; installation defaults are supplied separately by the settings owner.
RedactionPolicy.enabled 92 Resolve a declared source to its boolean field; unknown source names raise instead of silently choosing another consumer.
RedactionPolicy.with_all 97 Build a new policy with the same value for every declared source, using ordinary strict constructor validation.
RedactionPolicy.to_mapping 102 Return a detached plain mapping for accepted snapshots and the authenticated transport envelope.
RedactionPolicy.from_mapping 108 Require a mapping of declared policy field names. The dataclass rejects unknown keys and non- boolean values; omitted fields keep the off fallback.
RedactionPolicy.from_settings 116 Read only the twenty redaction preference keys from a settings mapping, default missing keys off, and validate their values without coercion.
setting_key 122 Map a valid consumer identity to its stable settings key, shared by settings capture and UI registry consumers.
configure_settings 146 Bind the existing application settings reader; do not create a settings store.
unbind_settings 152 Release only the closing application's reader, never a newer owner.
ProjectionContext 191 One response/batch's immutable live policy plus its accepted run override.
current_policy 202 Resolve the active ContextVar override against live settings, reusing a response projection scope when present. A nested run policy can replace snapshot sources without rereading settings; provider and validation errors propagate.
projection_scope 212 Resolve settings once, reuse nested projections, discard before streaming waits. This scope is a consumer boundary, never an execution policy or process cache. Run policy_scope overrides still apply to SNAPSHOT_SOURCES, including nested ones. Do not hold this context across a generator yield or the lifetime of an SSE stream.
policy_scope 235 Bind a validated run policy to this execution context and restore its previous value on every exit, including exceptions. This does not alter global settings.
MatchMode 247 Distinguish field-only provenance, whole-string matching, literal substring matching and explicit encoded variants; a field-only material never becomes a global substring rule.
SecretMaterial 258 Carry one credential string, its provenance and its intended matching mode. These immutable values can be retained in the bounded matcher cache; they are not a credential store or authorization grant.
RedactionContext 267 Describe one projection's explicit materials, normalized sensitive field names, decoded query names and whole-record sensitivity. Hashable immutable fields allow matcher reuse.
field_name 310 Normalize camelCase and hyphen/dot/whitespace-separated field names to lower snake case before exact sensitive-name lookup.
secret_key 317 Classify only a normalized exact member of the credential-name set; a name containing an unrelated key/token substring is not enough.
scalars 323 Yield nonempty strings from mapping values and list/tuple contents for explicit field discovery. Callers supply acyclic structures; this helper does not bound depth or inspect arbitrary objects.
secret_fields 334 Explicit field provenance only; sensitive record metadata is never provenance.
secret_variants 351 Deduplicate explicit strings, add URL/plus/JSON-escaped variants, and order longest first for deterministic replacement. Empty strings and the opaque marker are excluded.
context_for 360 Wrap explicitly supplied nonempty credential strings with encoded-substring provenance and combine caller-supplied field/query/record metadata.
known_secrets 371 Compatibility discovery for enabled projections, never a global store scan.
_Matcher 387 Compile one immutable context into whole-string matches, longest-first substring alternatives and credential/URL recognizers. It produces consumer copies only; no persistence, execution decision or model call occurs.
_Matcher.url 424 Replace URL userinfo and sensitive query/fragment values while retaining path and ordinary fields. Invalid URL parsing returns the original value; this is a display transformation, not URL validation.
_Matcher.text 454 Mask exact strings, recursively project JSON object/array text when parseable, then handle URLs, private keys, assignments, auth tokens and explicit substrings. Enabled JSON projection may change textual formatting; never use it as canonical input.
_Matcher.walk 477 Copy mappings/lists/tuples and mask classified fields or sensitive-record scalar leaves. Job- log metadata enables conservative page-edge masking without changing retained offsets. Unrecognized objects and undecodable bytes pass through; there is no cycle/depth guard in this optional walker.
_Matcher.page_seams 536 Mask the longest known-secret suffix/prefix matching an exposed page boundary, even when the complete secret is absent from that page. Overlapping boundary matches can mask the whole fragment; the raw log and cursor remain unchanged.
RedactionProcessor 565 Capture one effective policy for a value or stream projection. Disabled sources preserve identity and skip lazy context construction; enabled sources share the central matcher.
RedactionProcessor.enabled 572 Delegate consumer selection to the captured policy without discovering credentials or traversing data.
RedactionProcessor.process 577 Return the exact input when disabled. Otherwise resolve a lazy or supplied context and return the matcher's projection; context, traversal and policy failures are not silently suppressed.
RedactionProcessor.stream 585 Return an unbuffered identity stream when disabled, or a fresh stateful stream using the context matcher when enabled. Its policy is captured at stream creation.
_IdentityStream.feed 597 Return each fragment verbatim, including the final fragment, without buffering or masking work.
_RedactionStream 604 Hold incomplete text until matches can be projected across fragment boundaries. Long recognized credentials use delimiter-discard state rather than retaining their full body; blocked remains false for compatibility.
_RedactionStream.feed 618 Consume any ongoing long-token discard, append the fragment, and flush on final. Ordinary output retains at least max(8192, longest explicit variant) characters until safe boundaries; regex-spanning tokens can delay emission, and oversized uninterrupted URLs become one marker. Large incoming fragments still allocate before trimming.
project 698 Resolve the source policy and return the original value before evaluating context when off; otherwise adapt explicit secrets or the supplied context into the central processor.
redact 705 Legacy model-input projection; new callers must select an explicit source.
safe_url 712 Project a display URL under the live URL source, optionally marking one exact query name as sensitive. It neither validates a destination nor changes the URL sent to a provider.
RedactingLogFilter 727 Apply optional LOGS projection to a logging record in place while preserving the logger's formatting contract. A closed workspace cannot supply its policy, so discard its record rather than emitting unredacted data or interrupting a shutdown/retry response. Disabling the policy leaves every field untouched while settings remain available.
RedactingLogFilter.filter 736 Preserve Uvicorn's five-field access tuple and numeric status, but project its other values. Other records are formatted before masking; exceptions become projected exc_text and their raw exc_info is cleared.
NativeRedactingSink 772 Compatibility sink adapter; delegates to the sink's explicitly owned source.
NativeRedactingSink.emit 783 Project only event title, summary and details using the sink-owned source, then deliver a copied event. Downstream errors and return values propagate; the original event is retained.
Redactor 794 Compatibility adapter for legacy model-output callers; source selection remains fixed to MODEL_OUTPUT.
Redactor.redact 796 Delegate a value to model-output projection without becoming a second masking implementation.
output_materials 806 Bind explicit output materials to this context for nested projections, restoring the previous material set on exit.
projection_materials 816 Combine caller and scoped output materials in first-seen order only when some optional source is enabled. This helper does not discover stored credentials.
OutputStream 822 Model-output projection only; cannot reject, retry or change provider data.
OutputStream.feed 837 Forward fragments and the final-flush flag to the selected identity or masking stream; this adapter cannot reject or retry provider output.
